body.prompt: Instrumental loop, 88 BPM, 4/4, F minor, minor key throughout with no major sections. Instrumental only, no vocals with words. A hypnotic, endlessly repeating minor-key synth arpeggio in F minor on a warm, slightly detuned analog synthesizer with tape wobble and wow; a slow, deep, round synth bass that moves once a bar; a soft muffled steady kick and faint brushed noise; a dark airy pad; over it, a simple eerie lead melody of a few long, wobbling notes that you remember. Woozy, ominous and nocturnal, the feeling that something is out there in the dark. Never horror, no jump scares, no sudden loud hits. Hypnotic and pleasant to hear for an hour, mellow so it sits under people talking. Starts immediately with the full arrangement, no intro, same energy throughout, no build-up, no breakdown, no ending and no fade-out, so it can loop seamlessly.
